metadata.description: Technical portfolio website of Shinsa Yoshiya

profile.name: Shinza Yoshiya
profile.description:
Born in 2000. From Nonoichi, Ishikawa, Japan.
I'm studying various things with the aim of improving my technical skills.
I make games as a hobby.
Please contact me via direct message on X or Facebook.

shinza-s-portfolio-v1.title: Shinza's Portfolio Ver. 1
shinza-s-portfolio-v1.description:
An older portfolio website created as part of learning TypeScript and Next.js.
It showcases personal projects and career history.
Supports Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.
The source code is publicly available on GitHub.

shinza-s-portfolio-v2.title: Shinza's Portfolio Ver. 2
shinza-s-portfolio-v2.description:
A renewed portfolio website rebuilt to refresh both design and technology.
It showcases personal projects and career history.
Supports Japanese, English, Mandarin Chinese, Taiwanese Mandarin, and Korean. ChatGPT is used for language translation.
The source code is publicly available on GitHub.

translate-number-to-strings.title: Translate number to strings
translate-number-to-strings.description:
A simple website created using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Converts numbers into English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean.
The site is published using GitHub Pages.
The source code is publicly available on GitHub.

zenn.title: Zenn technical article
zenn.description:
I publish technical articles on a technical knowledge community.
Topics include Unity and Amazon ECS.
As this is a Japanese service, the content is available in Japanese only.

towa-2d.title: Towa 2D
towa-2d.description:
A side-scrolling game created using Unity.
Developed to test input-related systems and localization.
A simple game where you defeat enemies and aim for the goal.
The character voice was provided by a friend from my high school days.
Supports Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Indonesian. Voice is available in Japanese only.
The source code is publicly available on GitHub.

clicker-game.title: Clicker game
clicker-game.description:
A mini-game where you simply click an octopus.
Created as a review of C++ and DirectX learned during my student days.
Rendering and core systems are built using DirectX 11.
The octopus pixel art was actually created using Aseprite.
The source code is publicly available on GitHub.

discord-bot.title: Discord Bot
discord-bot.description:
A Discord bot developed with various features.
Includes text-to-speech, automatic role assignment, birthday celebrations, and commands.
The bot runs on Amazon ECS, and the text-to-speech feature is implemented using VOICEVOX running in Docker.
The source code is private for security and privacy reasons.

unity-2d-rpg.title: 2D RPG
unity-2d-rpg.description:
A 2D RPG currently in development using Unity.
Due to the large development scope, completion is expected to take time.
Planned to be released on Steam in the future.
The source code is private.

unity-visual-novel.title: Visual novel game
unity-visual-novel.description:
A visual novel game currently being developed using Unity.
The project also serves as a test for localization and save systems.
Planned to be completed and released on Steam within 2026.
The source code is private.
